  WHY: Correct classification (timeout vs OOM), but log message uses original (pre-clamp) value in last_status="codex timeout 137 (${ORCHESTRATE_DECOMPOSER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS}s)", misleading operators on actual enforced budget.
